info.name: Moodle Deck Sync
info.summary: Seamlessly sync Moodle course groups and assignments with Nextcloud Deck Kanban boards for agile student collaboration.
info.description:
**Moodle Deck Sync** connects course-driven learning in Moodle with agile, visual task management in Nextcloud Deck.
### Why Moodle Deck Sync? While Moodle excels at course management, grading, and submissions, student project groups often struggle with fragmented communication and external unmanaged tools. Moodle Deck Sync bridges this gap by bringing real-time collaborative Kanban boards into your self-hosted Nextcloud environment.
### Key Capabilities - **Automated Board Provisioning:** Instantly generates dedicated Nextcloud Deck boards when group assignments are configured in Moodle. - **Structured Project Stacks:** Pre-populates boards with standardized project stacks (To Do, In Progress, Under Review, Done) to jumpstart student workflows. - **Role-Aware Access Control:** Moodle instructors automatically receive board administration privileges while enrolled students gain collaborative editing rights. - **Idempotent & Secure Sync:** Powered by HMAC SHA-256 signed webhooks, replay protection, and an event ledger to guarantee reliable synchronization without duplicate boards. - **Lifecycle & Archival Management:** Automatically archives boards when course groups conclude, supporting customizable retention and cleanup policies. - **Enterprise Privacy & Compliance:** Keeps all student discussions, task attachments, and project assets safely inside your institutional Nextcloud boundary (GDPR/FERPA friendly).
### Requirements & Documentation - Nextcloud 34 - Nextcloud Deck 1.18.2 or compatible - PHP 8.3+ - Moodle instance with the companion `local_nextclouddeck` plugin. - Product Documentation: [elearning23.com/nextcloud-deck-sync-for-moodle](https://elearning23.com/nextcloud-deck-sync-for-moodle/) - Nextcloud App Store: [apps.nextcloud.com/apps/moodle_deck_sync](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/moodle_deck_sync)
